name: Verina

tierList.prydwen: T0.5 Tower of Adversity, T1 Whimpering Wastes - one of the two premier generalist Supports

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Rectifier generalist Support/healer with the shortest rotation in the game (as fast as ~2.35s at S2). Forte 'Photosynthesis Energy' (max 4, from Basic 5/Skill/Intro) consumed via Mid-air Attack for healing + Concerto. Notably her Intro Skill is considered unusable (launches her airborne, slows rotation) so it's typically skipped.

skills.resonanceSkill: Botany Experiment - Spectro DMG AoE, generates good Resonance Energy, typically instant-cancelled via Ultimate.
skills.forte: Starflower Blooms - Heavy/Mid-air Attack variant consuming Photosynthesis Energy for team heal + Concerto.
skills.liberation: Arboreal Flourish - Spectro DMG + team heal, applies Photosynthesis Mark (nearby attacks trigger Verina Coordinated Attacks + healing).
skills.intro: Verdant Growth - Spectro DMG (rarely used in optimal rotations).
skills.outro: Blossom - HoT to next character (19% ATK/s for 6s) + 15% all-type DMG Deepen to nearby team for 30s.

echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (best, +15% team ATK on heal)

mainStats.cost3: Energy Regen (both 3-cost); Energy Regen / Spectro DMG

teams.name: Generalist Support (any team)
teams.notes: Slots into virtually any team; slightly behind The Shorekeeper in raw buff strength but has by far the shortest rotation, making her preferred in quickswap and some Jinhsi teams (Coordinated Attacks synergy).

rotation: S0 (~3.75s): swap in (no Intro) -> Basic P3-P5 -> Skill (cancelled by Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Jump -> Mid-air Starflower Blooms P1-P3 -> Outro. S2 (~2.35s): skip most basics, straight to Skill after Basic P3.
communityNotes: Prydwen: top-tier (essentially T0) universal generalist Support, comfortably the fastest-rotating support in the game; her only real flaw is a near-unusable Intro Skill (skipped in favor of feeding an extra Intro to a teammate). Marginally weaker buffs than The Shorekeeper but makes up for it with rotation speed, making her the preferred choice in quickswap-heavy compositions.
